_note: Story Bits pieces made by the engine at 74cadb6, before what happened and how they feel had frames. Never regenerate: they stand for links people already shared.

pieces.line: My dentist's ex got their boating license for the second time this year, and they are excited about it.
Her possibly a ghost brother finally lost his dog, and he is quietly thrilled and blames a jar of pickled eggs.
Her aggressively cheerful bartender's old boss's very online ex-girlfriend finished a 1,000-piece puzzle, and she is proud.
Their grandmother accidentally got a parking ticket outside her own house at age seventy, and she is kind of worried sick.
Our recently retired plumber won the office chili cook-off, and he is embarrassed.
Your sister secretly got called for jury duty, and she is suspiciously furious and blames a spoon.
A mom started learning the accordion during a eulogy, and she is devastated.
Her extremely punctual barber once again replied-all to the entire company, and he is aggressively confused.
The self-published brother beat his personal record at the community pool, and he is calm about it.
My ex-husband posthumously got asked to be a godparent in a dream, but legally, and he is legally at peace and blames a mime costume.
Your self-published ex-girlfriend got her wisdom teeth out, and she is not sure how to feel.
My chronically early neighbor luckily missed her flight by eleven seconds, and she is calling it the best day of her life.
Our cousin Dale got a tattoo of a lighthouse in front of everyone, and he is pretending it doesn't bother him.
The high school chemistry teacher yet again got mistaken for a minor local celebrity, and he is hoping nobody brings it up at Thanksgiving and blames a folding chair.
My seven-foot kid down the street got banned from a Costco, and they are telling everyone it was their plan all along.
Our seven-foot therapist just inherited a single, very old goose thanks to an accordion, and she is already planning the sequel.
Her roommate got stuck in an elevator with a mime, and they are throwing a party about it.
The uncle's therapist's lab partner recently lost a bet, and they are treating it like a personal betrayal and blame a recliner.
His allegedly immortal uncle won a perfect score on a radio trivia call-in on live local television, and he is considering a lawsuit.
Their guy from the coffee shop somehow gave a toast at a stranger's wedding, and he is refusing to discuss it before noon.
Someone's unusually calm bartender grew a tomato shaped exactly like Ohio, and they are certain it's a sign from the universe.

My recently resurrected dad allegedly found out he was adopted (by a different set of the same parents) while being followed by a spoon, and he is humming about it constantly and blames a taxidermy owl.
Our lab partner had their sourdough starter declared a legal dependent, and they are in mourning, with a black armband and everything.
His college roommate ceremonially got elected treasurer of a club they never joined, and they are keeping a candle lit until further notice.
A conspiracy-minded work wife discovered her house is technically in another state on her birthday, and she is drafting a memoir.
Their yoga instructor spiritually got hired to name a new shade of beige, and she is secretly heartbroken and blames a ventriloquist dummy named Gerald.
The sister received a strongly worded letter from a lighthouse, and she is livid.
Her semi-retired upstairs neighbor inexplicably found a second, smaller fridge inside his fridge because of a rotary phone, and he is acting like nothing happened.
Her extremely blond landlord got demoted to assistant regional manager of nothing, and they are lighting incense about it.
A mom legally got chosen by a swan, and she is ghostwriting her own biography and blames a taxidermy owl.
His barber became a grandparent with help from a kayak, and he is telling the bees.
Our formerly famous bartender finally got bitten by the neighbor's cat, and they are kind of excited about it.
His self-published best friend got bumped up to first class, and she is thrilled.
His upstairs neighbor accidentally won a goat in a church raffle for the second time this year, and he is suspiciously proud and blames an accordion.
Someone's suspiciously tan dentist got his luggage sent to Belgium without him, and he is worried sick.
Her intern secretly got custody of the family ghost, and they are aggressively embarrassed.
Her gym teacher inexplicably finished a 1,000-piece puzzle, and he is refusing to discuss it before noon in a way that worries the family.
The mail carrier just got her wisdom teeth out, and she is quietly proud and has started a podcast about it.
